lesson.menu_desc: Telling a client what is going to happen to the fee -- the same question answered three times -- 13 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 17 -- Four Percent in January
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fábia | Lesson 17 -- Four Percent in January

listenings.text: Well, the price changes a little every year, I think. It depends on inflation, more or less. We tell our clients before it changes, of course. And it is never a very big increase.

Good question. In January, we are going to adjust the fee. The adjustment is going to follow the inflation index, and this year it is about four percent. We are going to send you notice thirty days before. And the increase is not going to go above our cap of six percent.
